questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Food webs show interconnected feeding relationships.
options: Food webs show interconnected feeding relationships.
Every animal eats exactly one kind of food.
Changing one population cannot affect any others.
A simple food chain includes every ecological relationship.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Food webs show interconnected feeding relationships.

source.en: Ecologists therefore test predictions in particular environments rather than assuming that every disturbance produces an identical sequence of events.
source.tr: Bu nedenle ekolojistler her bozulmanın aynı olay dizisini oluşturduğunu varsaymak yerine öngörüleri belirli çevrelerde sınar.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: Every animal eats exactly one kind of food.
